args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

round_money advertised banker's rounding in its docstring but was
implemented with ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail.

Replace ROUND_HALF_UP with ROUND_HALF_EVEN so halfway values round to
the nearest even cent.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py::round_money` documented banker's rounding per FIN-212 but was implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing `tests/test_money.py` to fail in the nightly build.
- Replaced `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so halfway values (e.g. `2.675` -> `2.68`, `2.665` -> `2.66`) round to the nearest even cent.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed.

**Fix:**

3. Ran CI on the branch (run `ci-0001`) — **passed**.
